name: Mieres (Asturias, Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, blue and yellow with a broad white upper stripe, charged towards the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Mieres (the Victory Cross, crossed hammers and waves on white and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Mieres; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Mieres arms — Victory Cross, hammers and waves
